Committed as **f5f265c** on `feat/auto-draft-on-scan` (not pushed, no PR opened, per instructions).

**What was built:**

1. `Config.autoDraftOnScan?: boolean` added to `src/lib/types.ts` and its zod mirror in `src/lib/config/schema.ts`, following the exact `roleArea`/`schedule`/`applyProfile` optional pattern (omitted/false = no behavior change).

2. `src/scheduler/index.ts`: new exported `runAutoDraft()` helper, called from `runCycle()` right after the existing cycle summary log. It:
   - No-ops immediately if `config.autoDraftOnScan` isn't true.
   - Checks `process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `config.applyProfile` **once per cycle** (not per-gig) — logs exactly one line naming whichever is missing and returns.
   - Filters `result.passed` to `tier === "green"` AND `getDraft(gigKey(...)) === undefined` (any existing draft status excludes the gig), caps at the new exported `AUTO_DRAFT_CAP = 5`.
   - Calls `stageApplication()` per eligible gig inside a try/catch so one failure never stops the rest, then logs a one-line `"N gig(s) auto-drafted this cycle."` summary.
   - Added `stageApplicationFn`/`getDraftFn` as injectable `SchedulerOptions`, mirroring the existing `runRadarFn` injection pattern — this keeps tests free of real Anthropic calls or a live DB, matching this codebase's own convention exactly.

3. Tests: 8 new cases added to `src/scheduler/__tests__/index.test.ts`, one per acceptance criterion in the story YAML (no-op when unset/false, missing-key single log line, missing-applyProfile single log line, already-drafted-any-status exclusion, 5-per-cycle cap, yellow/red never drafted, one failure doesn't block the rest, one-line success summary).

**Test results:** `npm test` — 546 passed, 3 skipped (pre-existing skips, unrelated), 45 files passed, 1 skipped file, 0 failures. `npm run typecheck` — clean, no errors.

**Self-review against every AC in `.pHive/epics/auto-draft-on-scan/stories/auto-draft-on-scan.yaml`:** all 8 acceptance criteria and all 3 design decisions (once-per-cycle prerequisite checks, any-status draft exclusion, fixed non-configurable cap of 5) are implemented and each has a dedicated test. No changes were made to `stageApplication()`, `generateDraft()`, or the review/approve UI, as required.
